description: An older man with swept-back grey hair and a white lab coat stands in the foreground holding a glass syringe up to the light and looking down at it. Behind him, a nurse in a dark dress and white cap stands by iron-frame hospital beds, and a seated patient in a plain gown sits on one bed. The room has tall arched windows, dark plaster walls and a wooden floor, and the whole scene is a dim, painterly oil style. I see no text, no frame, and nothing graphic.
